name: ai-plugins
description: Marketplace for Claude Code plugins published from github.com/wcy/ai-plugins

plugins.name: metacoder
plugins.description: Spec-to-ship workflow for one or several interdependent repositories: write contract-level specs (mspec), reverse-engineer them from existing code (mreverse), plan implementations (mplan), deliver slice by slice as worktree-isolated waves with each slice's acceptance proven red-before-green (mship), and verify conformance and repair the drift it finds (mverify)
